checks.detail: Fresh candidate-bound boot observation reached rendered gameplay without a black screen, missing-resource failure, or runtime error.
Ordinary movement, horizontal and vertical mouse look, mouse capture, and F6 restart produced the expected runtime responses with stable framing and grounded state.
The runnable shell and basic input/camera loop remain supported by fresh candidate-bound runtime evidence.
Prior accepted evidence still supports the intact authored environment, grounded spawn, human scale, and foundation route budget; the correction did not reopen that accepted phase verdict.

Runtime reports one Standoff authored-environment instance with 11 visible meshes/material slots, 30,379 collision triangles, and ready navigation without evidence of authored-child extraction or proxy-world replacement.
The previously accepted map-integration verdict remains preserved; no correction evidence established package-level incompatibility or source mutation.

A continuous ordinary-input attempt advanced the authoritative timer and event sequence for most of the round but never produced Alpha overlap or capture: Alpha and Bravo remained held_rift, keys stayed empty, and checkpoint version stayed 0. The required A-to-B-to-C sequence is therefore unreachable in the observed candidate.
The current mission traversal could not reach Alpha through the collision-backed spawn route, so connected ordinary-input traversal across Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, and their route alternatives fails.
The complete live UI hierarchy has no minimap control, map footprint, player arrow, or A/B/C map-marker surface in either square or circular configuration.

At 1280x720 the complete instantiated UI contains 22 Controls: the combat subtree contains only weapon/ammo labels, state labels, a primitive reticle, and result label; the mission subtree contains only an opaque 388x122 top panel plus text labels. There are no minimap, health, compass, interaction-progress, or directional-damage controls. Authoritative runtime health is 100 and mission state reports timer, keys, locks, and overlaps, but several required values have no rendered owner.

The weapon-impact repair remains verified. The live opening/mission presentation nevertheless has no VideoStreamPlayer or TextureRect fallback, and its instantiated Event label uses a null/default font with cyan color RGBA approximately (0.28,0.90,1.0,1.0), not the required yellow outlined narrative treatment. These directly observed launch-state defects independently fail the criterion.

F6 restored authoritative checkpoint version 0 with time_granted 0, but the blocked Alpha route prevents the required accepted Alpha and Bravo checkpoint states and controlled-death restoration from existing in the observed run.

The integrated phase cannot pass while objective progression is unreachable and the required minimap, tactical HUD, opening media fallback, and narrative treatment are concretely absent from the live candidate.

required_criteria.requirement: Launch a minimal native Godot prototype with a simple bounded placeholder room, a player camera and ordinary keyboard/mouse input. This is an intentionally rough first increment: do not import the authored FPS map, real weapon or hand assets, HUD package, minimap package, enemy package or decorative asset collection. Verify the game starts without a black screen, missing-resource error or direct dependency on final content.

Use ordinary input to look and move the placeholder player inside the bounded prototype. Require stable camera framing, a visible floor, predictable input capture/release and a deterministic restart state. Placeholder geometry is permitted and expected; production scale, authored landmarks, weapons, HUD and map quality are explicitly out of scope.

Issue one narrow bootstrap verdict for the launchable placeholder loop. Accept only a real runnable shell and basic camera/input evidence; do not expand this first phase into map import, weapon implementation, HUD, minimap, enemy AI or final presentation.

Replace the accepted placeholder blockout with exactly one complete authored FPS environment from the asset pool. Launch through ordinary input and traverse its spawn-to-Alpha route. Require the PRD's 30-45 second effective spawn-to-A route budget with meaningful native cover and route decisions; reject moving Alpha close to spawn, shortening the route to make collision validation pass, or reporting a below-target route as acceptable. Require human-scale collision-backed ground, a fixed safe spawn, readable cover and landmarks, neutral daylight exposure, and no roof spawn, void, fall-through, decorative barriers, loose model placement or modular kit scatter. The authored map is first allowed in this phase; do not add real weapon/hand components, HUD, minimap or enemy AI yet.

Inspect the imported environment's complete native hierarchy, bounds, materials, collision and route datum. Require one intact instance supplying the dominant visible world, with product-owned outer support only. Reject extracted child meshes, broad proxy floors, cloned facades, missing textures, floating anchors, disconnected streets, raw-AABB minimap assumptions and source mutation.

Issue one map-integration verdict for the playable authored spawn-to-Alpha environment. The complete map, ground contact, collision, scale and route must be coherent in one ordinary-input run, and the route must preserve the PRD's 30-45 second effective travel budget rather than relocating Alpha to a trivial near-spawn endpoint. Do not require later weapon, HUD, minimap, enemy AI or cinematic behavior in this phase.

Complete the connected mission route through ordinary input in the required A-to-B-to-C order. Require physically separated Alpha and Bravo capture zones, two committed disarm keys, route unlocks and checkpoints, a distinct Charlie bomb interaction radius, three legal defusal stages, interruption by leaving or damage, and an authoritative timer that never pauses merely because the player approaches or interacts with the bomb.

Traverse spawn, Alpha, Bravo, Charlie and their main/flank/retreat connections in the intact preferred authored FPS map. Require map-scale boundaries derived from actual walkable topology rather than raw AABB, fixed safe ground spawns, distinct landmarks and cover at all objectives, no roof/void access, no disconnected facades, no added decorative roadblocks, and no modular kit scatter used to replace the complete environment.

Inspect the reusable dynamic minimap in square and circular configurations. It must derive its footprint from the real walkable map boundary, tightly crop excess empty space, show only letter markers A, B and C without colored label backgrounds, place A toward the lower-right, B near the middle and C toward the upper-left according to their actual world anchors, keep north fixed, rotate the player arrow with camera yaw, and never reveal enemies without valid knowledge.

At 1280x720, validate the first live tactical HUD: minimap, health, armor if present, weapon/ammo, compass, five-minute detonation timer, A/B key state, C bomb state, world markers, interaction progress, damage direction and mission text. Require transparent or borderless grounded presentation matching the PRD references, non-default typography, no opaque AI-style cards or dark-blue framing, and state agreement within two rendered frames.

Run briefing text, typewriter timing, route unlocks, capture transitions, countdown warnings, damage interruption and all three defusal stages. Verify native yellow outlined narrative text, first-pass opening video or matching still fallback, surface impacts, directional damage, objective light changes, mechanical defusal sounds and event-bound VFX/audio. Missing media must degrade to a coherent still rather than black screen, placeholder label or blocked mission state.

Restart after controlled damage/death at the accepted Alpha and Bravo checkpoints. Require mission time, objective/key/route state, player transform, weapons, ammo, health and HUD to restore from one authoritative snapshot without duplicating time, score, signals, nodes or interactions. Ordinary death uses the grayscale recovery branch and must not trigger bomb explosion presentation.

Issue one integrated no-enemy-AI verdict for the complete A-to-B-to-C traversal, two keys, checkpoints, three-stage bomb interaction, minimap, truthful HUD, opening story and first feedback layer. Preserve all accepted foundation behavior and name the highest-impact blocker without demanding the phase-three enemy force, full cinematic polish or final product shell.
